info.title: Space DOGE API
info.description:
Wallet-first Coin Rush Arena with verifiable Scrypt cloud-mining rewards. Every endpoint below reflects the actual current implementation — request/response shapes were transcribed directly from the route handlers, not hand-guessed.

**Auth**: almost every endpoint requires a session, established via `/api/auth/verify` (SIWE sign-in), which sets an httpOnly `SpaceDOGE_session` cookie. Admin endpoints (`/api/admin/*`) additionally require the session's wallet address to be on the admin allowlist (env `ADMIN_ADDRESSES` or the `AdminUser` table) — a non-admin session hitting those returns `403`, not `401`.

**Money fields**: all Decimal/Prisma fields are converted to plain JSON `number` before being returned — never strings.

**Timestamps**: all dates are ISO-8601 strings in responses.
